combo1.title: The Peeper's Full Combo
combo1.description: A full Toon combo line featuring Toon World the Perfect World setup, Dugares Xyz play, and a devastating end board of Firewall Dragon Singularity, Tri-Gate Wizard, Charmer Quartet in Bloom, Comic Cat, and Firewall Dragon. Heads-up: this line uses Protectcode Talker, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

combo2.title: Kale's Toon Synchro/Link Bridge into Red-Eyes Toon Dragon
combo2.description: A go-first line built on the Jet Synchron / Crystron Halqifibrax engine, bridging through Linkuriboh, Linkross, and Barricadeborg Blocker into Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon. Auroradon floods the field with Deskbot 001 copies and Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion to Synchro Summon Accel Synchron, then bridges further into Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light. Toon Kingdom closes out the turn, banishing Toon Mermaid, Toon Dark Magician, and a hand monster to Special Summon Red-Eyes Toon Dragon. Heads-up: this line uses Crystron Halqifibrax, Linkross, Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon, Borreload Savage Dragon and Herald of the Arc Light, which are Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.
